description: This Python source file defines functions for generating C++ code related to JSON-RPC event and method registration for a plugin system. It handles emission of C++ function prototypes, registration/deregistration code, and event handling logic based on JSON schema data, primarily for RPC emitter code generation.

methods.name: EmitEvent(emit, root, event, params_type, legacy = False)
methods.description: Generates C++ code for emitting a specific JSON-RPC event, including function prototype and body, with handling for legacy and different parameter types.

methods.name: _EmitRpcPrologue(root, emit, header_file, source_file, ns, data_emitted, prototypes = [])
methods.description: Emits the prologue portion of the RPC code, including includes, namespace declarations, and version info.

methods.name: _EmitRpcEpilogue(root, emit, ns)
methods.description: Emits the epilogue portion of the RPC code, closing namespaces.

methods.name: _EmitVersionCode(emit, version)
methods.description: Emits C++ namespace with version constants.

methods.name: _EmitRpcCode(root, emit, ns, header_file, source_file, data_emitted)
methods.description: Main function that generates the entire RPC registration code, including method registration, event registration, and version info.

methods.name: EmitRpcCode(root, emit, header_file, source_file, data_emitted)
methods.description: Top-level function to generate complete RPC code, including prologue and epilogue.

methods.name: EmitRpcVersionCode(root, emit, header_file, source_file, data_emitted)
methods.description: Function to generate RPC version code and handle related prologue/epilogue.
